newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol hires sales executive from NBC.
newsitem.headline: Endemol hires sales executive from NBC.

text.p: Dutch television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Thursday it had appointed Matthew Ody as executive vice president for international sales.
Ody joins Endemol from NBC International in New York where he was vice president for international sales.
Endemol said Ody's recruitment was part of plans to set up a distribution unit within its Endemol International subsidiary.

Up to now Endemol International has concentrated on acquiring and selling programme formats, selling its own ready-made productions and obtaining commissions to produce programmes for foreign broadcasters.

Endemol said that in addition to these activities it also wanted to branch out into the acquisition, co-financing and co-production of English-language drama series and television films of up to one and a half hours in length.
